notes: Rogers Pl. printed ROGERS PL. (width label 60' though the drawn street measures about 50 ft). St. James Av. is 60 ft north of Windsor and 50 ft south of it (east edge steps in at Windsor; centre about 3606 north, 3590 south). North of Rogers Pl. St. James continues only as dashed (unopened) lines bearing NNE. Windsor, Francisco and Nassau printed without suffix ('Street' added). Nassau is 55 ft west of Sinton and 60 ft east of it. Windsor/Gilbert is the same junction as on sheet 187. Fulton begins at Windsor and runs south past Nassau; Francisco runs only Fulton to St. James. St. James ends at Nassau (south edge of Nassau continuous). Sinton Av. (Grand) runs from Gilbert to past Nassau; Sinton/Gilbert is an acute junction, centreline crossing north of the block corners. Unnamed 10 ft alley in block 4 from Francisco to Nassau.
